title: Independent NPA test of chemoselective imine reduction
difficulty_reasons: The geometry and two atom identities are fixed, so there is no candidate search or route-discovery space.
The task is a direct validated charge calculation with a bounded interpretation and an explicitly reportable failure path.

data.description: 67-atom neutral Cartesian geometry of compound 3a; atom indices are XYZ coordinate-line order.

required_deliverables.description: Validated calculation provenance, atom mapping, NPA charges when obtained or bounded-failure diagnostics, comparison, interpretation, and limitations.
